ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, what does fruit get its energy source from?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, “fruit” is labeled near the lower right, with a picture of fruit beside it; the yellow “sun” icon is on its right side. An arrow from sun to fruit can be seen, with the arrowhead pointing toward fruit. Reasoning: Food web arrows indicate the direction of energy flow; fruit has an incoming arrow from sun, therefore the energy source of fruit is sun.
